output.source_text: Technique 4: Colorful Dominant. Play a diminished 7th chord starting a half-step above the root of a dominant 7th chord (e.g., playing Ab°7 over G in the bass). This creates a dominant 7th flat 9 chord (G7(b9)).

note_vi: Bài 40 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 07:38-09:45. Technique 4: Colorful Dominant. Play a diminished 7th chord starting a half-step above the root of a dominant 7th chord (e.g., playing Ab°7 over G in the bass). This creates a dominant 7th flat 9 chord (G7(b9)).
